scenes.text: You are walking through a lush rainforest, and suddenly, a tree literally explodes next to you, launching shrapnel at highway speeds.
Growing eighty feet tall, this terrifying plant is covered in massive, razor-sharp thorns from top to bottom.
When they ripen, they don't just fall, they burst open with a loud bang, firing seeds at one hundred fifty miles per hour.
Even worse, the tree drips toxic sap that causes severe skin blisters.
